entries.translation: n., kusira, usiko, ha kusindikiziza; ha kumarigisiza; ha kugomera; point, ts'a; v., ku-goma, ku-mala [see CHIP]; ku-sira. To make an e. of, ku-marigisa, ku-gonya.
entries.context: Kigiryama Vocabulary & Collections (Taylor 1891) • Cross-verified with Lingua-Connect Giriama Dataset (CC-BY-4.0)

entries.translation: v., ku-ona, ku-sikira; to feel about, ku-hahasa, ku-gut'a-gut'a; I feel pain, naona utsungu; feel hurt, naona ku-lumira; I feel "all-overish," mwiri udzangira p'eho, hata sidzadima; feel queer, mwiri udzanihiririka; I feel cold, nasikira p'eho; hot, nasikira teri; I feel cool in danger, nidzasikira sogo-here (he ——, udzasikira k'aogo-here); I feel tired, nasikira kutsoka; feel for, as in the dark, or in dirty water, ku-wawata.
